metadata.title: Generic mean curvature flow has finitely many singularities
metadata.abstract: We show that for a generic compact initial surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$, and any generic compact initial mean convex hypersurface in higher dimensions, the mean curvature flow encounters only finitely many singularities. This resolves the full generic Morse regularity conjectures of Ilmanen and Colding-Minicozzi-Pedersen in the above two cases. More generally, we show that if a mean curvature flow of a compact hypersurface has only multiplicity one spherical and cylindrical singularities, then after a small perturbation of the initial condition only non-degenerate cylindrical and spherical singularities appear.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明泛型紧曲面及高维泛型紧均值凸超曲面的平均曲率流只有有限个奇点。
analysis.breakthrough: 在所述两类情形解决 Ilmanen 与 Colding–Minicozzi–Pedersen 的泛型 Morse 正则性猜想。
analysis.limitations: 高维结论要求均值凸；更广泛推广需先验证奇点类型假设。 本条数学解读依据官方摘要与评论；论文全文尚未作数学审读，AI 披露另行核查。
